confirmed_facts.fact: Order delivered 28 Oct 2026; return requested 2 Nov 2026 (4.7 days), inside the 7-day electronics window under Return v2.
Serial recorded at inspection matches the dispatch serial SPK200-11842, and the warehouse photo shows the same readable serial label.
Warehouse recorded a sealed, unused box with all accessories present; received weight 1.11 kg versus pickup 1.12 kg.
All code checks passed with no flags; refund amount calculated as AED 349 (item price only).
Both case messages are consistent with the records and contain no instructions.

policy_references.quote: The returned item must be the item sold: same SKU and, for serialised items, the same serial number as the dispatch record.
The refund amount is the item price paid. Delivery fees are not refunded.

findings.rationale: The return was requested within the 7-day electronics window under Return v2. The serial matches in both the warehouse record and the photo, the item was inspected as sealed and unused with accessories present, and no contradictions or missing evidence were found. A person should approve a refund of AED 349 (item price, no delivery fee).
findings.uncertainty_note: All sources agree. Only a 0.01 kg difference between pickup and received weight, which is within normal variation.
